notes.title: Nominated for IndieCade 2024!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that Music Power Up has been nominated for IndieCade 2024! It will be competing in the Audio Design category as well as for 5 other awards.

Many thanks to the team and jury at IndieCade!

IndieCade 2024 will be running online and on Steam from November 8th to November 16th.

Check out the event here:  https://www.indiecade.com/festival-2024/games/

notes.title: Back to School starting today - with Music Power Up
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that Music Power Up has been selected to be part of the Back to School Steam event by Mooncube Games!

The Back to School event celebrates the new school year with discounted educational games designed to enhance learning and productivity. The event page is filled with a variety of awesome games that encourage creativity, learning, and productivity. Don’t miss it—check it out here!

https://store.steampowered.com/sale/BacktoSchoolSale2024  

A big thanks to Mooncube Games for organizing this event and for including Music Power Up!

notes.title: Music Power Up is part of Tiny Teams 2024!
notes.content:
Music Power Up has been selected to be part of Tiny Teams 2024!

Tiny Teams is a festival that celebrates games made by solo developers and "micro-studios," showcasing everything from popular indie hits to hidden gems that could be the next "big thing." The festival takes place each summer.

My announcement is a bit late, but the event is still running on Steam for one more day. Check out the amazing selection of games here:
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/tinyteams2024

I’d also like to take this opportunity to introduce you to the team behind Music Power Up:

- Gilles Pommereuil (that’s me!) started Music Power Up as a solo dev two years ago. I’m also the creator of the free and open-source game engine microStudio.

- Jean Haffner is a recently graduated game artist who recently joined me to work full-time on the project. Jean spent a few weeks on the project in 2023 already and is extremely talented, taking our production to new heights I couldn't have dreamed of!

- Félix Bougrat is a young, highly skilled developer who interned with us in June, contributing to 3 of the minigames we're preparing for Music Power Up.

- An OG video game musician has recently started producing music for MPU. I’m thrilled to have him on the team, and we plan to reveal his name in a few months. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Working on the Music Power Up Demo!
notes.content:
Three months ago, I started communicating about Music Power Up, and I have been truly impressed by the reception it has received so far! I've gotten a lot of positive feedback every time I've posted about the game (mostly on Reddit). I want to extend my heartfelt thanks to everyone for your feedback; it's incredibly motivating, and now I'm even more excited.

One early suggestion was to create a demo, and I think it's a fantastic idea. For me, it represents a chance to focus on perfecting the core game systems early on, before finalizing all the content (full story, mini-games, etc.). I've written a prologue for the story that I believe turned out quite well! Without giving away too much, you'll get to meet several characters, delve into the backstory, start learning about sound, play games, create music, and embark on your first job as a video game music composer.

In both the demo and the full game, you'll have the ability to use the music app independently from the story. This allows you to create your own tracks and sound effects, save them, and export them. Music Power Up incorporates a mini-DAW that is both user-friendly and very capable! Naturally, the demo will have fewer features, reflecting the early stage of your career where not all functionalities are unlocked. However, you'll still be able to use it for crafting your own music. The demo will remain permanently available as a free "lite" version of Music Power Up. It is also set to become the official free music app on my game engine, microStudio.

The demo is planned for release around June 2024. Stay tuned for more updates! And now, back to work :-)
